DANIEL KNORR AT ODUNPAZARI MODERN MUSEUM! | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/130/
Snapshot: 20260613021150

Photo by Emre Derneklioğlu
Daniel Knorr’s site-specific installation
“Calligraphic Wig”
will be on view at
Odunpazarı Modern Museum in Eskişehir
from
October 25, 2025, to March 21, 2026
. A product of the artist’s time spent in plastic recycling factories in Hong Kong,
Calligraphic Wig
transforms the spontaneous forms that emerge when machines malfunction into subjects of art.
By turning the shapes born from the production and transformation processes of plastic into an artistic language,
Calligraphic Wig
invites viewers to confront the material’s potential. These accidental plastic formations sometimes resemble the letters of an unknown alphabet, sometimes deep-sea creatures, and at other times organic structures from other planets.
First exhibited at
Chungking Mansions
, the work draws inspiration from
Hong Kong’s cultural diversity and urban aesthetics
. Knorr coats some pieces in
automobile paint colors ranging from the 1970s to the present
, reestablishing the connection between industrial production and aesthetics, while leaving others in their raw state to highlight the material’s primal energy and accidental transformation.
More than a visual experience,
Calligraphic Wig
is also a
call for environmental awareness
and an exploration of
a new aesthetic language born from discarded materials
.
October 28, 2025
RELATED ARTIST
DANIEL KNORR

PİLEVNELİ AT ARTISSIMA WITH BORA AKINCITÜRK!
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/131/

Bora Akıncıtürk, Untitled, 2025. Photo by Gabriele Abbruzzese
PİLEVNELİ presents Bora Akıncıtürk’s solo project “The Interior” at Artissima’s Present Future section, booth 5!
Invited by Joel Valabrega and Léon Kruijswijk, the curators of Artissima 2025’s Present Future, Akıncıtürk presents a selection of works in his first art fair solo exhibition that continues his exploration of dystopia, overconsumption, and artistic independence, blending pop visuals, internet-sourced images, and personal ephemera.

Zümrütoğlu proposes an alternative model to the classical idea of the monument. It is destructive and constructive at once, material yet elusive. The visual field becomes a site of both loss and presence, a space for mourning and for reimagining. The works in the exhibition resist being confined to a single recognizable form; instead, they transform, mix, and fracture styles to construct a distinct visual narrative. Here, the visual field becomes a space for both loss and existence.
If you haven’t visited yet, the exhibition can be seen
Tuesday through Sunday, from 11:00 to 19:00
, at
Surp Yerrortutyun Armenian Catholic Church
(İstiklal Street, Perukar Çıkmazı, next to Odakule, No:14, Beyoğlu / Istanbul).
(Closed on Mondays.)
November 2, 2025

JOHAN CRETEN’S “LA LAGUNA” SCULPTURE AT TIFFANY & CO. DÜSSELDORF! | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/133/
Snapshot: 20260613032041

Photo by Marc Zimmermann
Johan Creten’s “La Laguna” (2021–2022) bronze sculpture greets visitors at the entrance of the new Tiffany & Co. store in Düsseldorf designed by Peter Marino. “La Laguna” is designed in a hybrid form that resembles a “seahorse” or an “underwater creature.” The sculpture evokes the feeling of a being emerging from the water or slowly taking shape beneath its surface. In this work, Creten focuses on themes of the sea, mythology, and transformation, as well as on concepts such as the passage of time, the fragility of ecosystems, and mystery.
Combining both mythological and contemporary references, “La Laguna” bridges classical sculptural forms with modern social and existential reflections. The work also plays on the artist’s recurring word association, “the sea and the mother / la mer / la mère” bringing together themes of nature, femininity, and creation in a metaphorical way. In this sense, “La Laguna” stands as a powerful example of Creten’s unique aesthetic that intertwines mythology, nature, and culture.
November 8, 2025

JOHAN CRETEN

================================================================================
Nevin Aladağ at “Shifting the Silence. Die Stille verschieben” group exhibiton at Lenbachhaus. | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/136/
Snapshot: 20260613025528

PREVIOUS
Next
Nevin Aladağ’s works from Raise the Roof are on view in the group exhibition “Shifting the Silence. Die Stille verschieben” curated by Eva Huttenlauch and Matthias Mühling at Lenbachhaus in Munich, Germany.
"Shifting the Silence" is the title of Etel Adnan's last book, published in 2021. The German translation "Die Stille verschieben" was published posthumously in 2022. Recognizably writing at the end of her life, Etel Adnan offers melancholy, poetic, and very personal thoughts on major themes of life.
The exhibition proposes appropriating a central concern of "Shifting the Silence": reflecting on the difficulty of fully verbalizing works of visual art and making them tangible. Linguization—i.e. the translation of artworks and aesthetic experiences into words and language—poses a challenge in many respects. Language is not only a means of communication, it is also limited and sometimes even a handicap when it comes to conveying complex impressions and perceptions. Etel Adnan suggests "shifting" silence—in other words, expanding the boundaries of what can be said and not rationalizing the poetic nature of the many forms of expression in the arts, but accepting it as an intrinsic value.
Performed in 2007 in the former East–West Berlin border zone, Raise the Roof features four female dancers moving independently to music unheard by the viewer, their stiletto heels amplified to create a powerful rhythm. The work explores control, freedom, and a distinct form of female resistance. Four pieces from the performance restaged by the artist at the 2017 Venice Biennale will be on view on December 9 in the new group exhibition opening on the terrace floor of PİLEVNELİ.
Photo: Lukas Schramm, Lenbachhaus
Video: Biennale Arte 2017
December 5, 2025

SERKAN SARIER IS PART OF A GROUP EXHIBITION AT HAUS. KUNST. MITTE. | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/139-serkan-sarier-haus.-kunst.-mitte.-de-duzenlenen-grup-sergisinde/
Snapshot: 20260415224505

The group exhibition “faces of mind”, featuring works by Serkan Sarıer, opens to the public on January 17 at HAUS. KUNST. MITTE.
Spanning a 50-year period, the exhibition brings together over 200 works by 50 artists. Featuring painting, sculpture, drawing, and photography, the selection approaches the portrait not as representation, but as a multi-layered experimental field shaped by form, emotion, and identity.
Through concepts such as reduction, fragmentation, and alienation, the exhibition offers new perspectives on the human condition, establishing a dialogue between artistic expression and neuroscientific approaches while questioning the impact of faces on perception, emotion, and memory.
The exhibition is initiated by collectors Dr. Carmen and Dr. Dietmar Peikert, in collaboration with the PECADI Foundation.
“faces of mind” is on view at HAUS. KUNST. MITTE. from January 17 to April 11, 2026.

“ONE MINUTE FOREVER”, ERWIN WURM'S FIRST SOLO EXHIBITION IN SERBIA | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/14/
Snapshot: 20260415222507

“One Minute Forever”, Erwin Wurm’s first solo exhibition in Serbia, takes place at the Museum of Contemporary Art Belgrade until August 9, 2022. Shedding light on the artist’s career from 1990s and onwards and curated by Maja Kolariç and Jerome Sans, the retrospective includes works such as the “Narrow House”, “Fat Car”, “Fat House”, as well as Wurm’s abstract and performative sculptures.
Erwin Wurm’s first exhibition at PILEVNELI will take place during fall in 2022.
Born in 1954, Wurm completed his education at the Graz University in 1977 and Gestaltungslehre University of Applied Arts and Academy of Fine Arts in 1982.
Erwin Wurm is known for his sculptural works that approach formalism with absurd and paradoxic compositions. Wurm creates his language and compositions through clothes, furniture, houses or everyday objects while criticizing the Western world and mentality, specifically the perception of society and everyday lifestyle post-World War II. Throughout his career of more than 30 years, Wurm redefines and expands the perception and meaning of sculpture, space and human form, depicting in his works familiar objects in unusual situations. In Wurm’s works, mundane and daily decisions are being questioned while seeking the answers to conceptual and existential questions. He questions how people define themselves through objects they use in their daily lives.
Erwin Wurm lives and works in Vienna and Limberg in Austria.
Erwin Wurm’s works are acquired by many prestigious collections including MoMA (USA), Berkeley Art Museum (USA), Rockford Art Museum (USA), Solomon R. Guggenheim Museum (USA), Judith Rotschild Foundation (USA), Berlinische Galerie (Germany), Kunsthalle Bremen (Germany), Museum Ludwig (Germany), Museum für Moderne Kunst (Germany), Sammlung Deutsche Bank (Germany), Städel Museum (Germany), Albertina (Austria), Kunsthaus Bregenz (Austria), MONA (Australia), National Gallery of Victoria (Australia), Centre Pompidou (France), Musée d’Art Contemporain de Lyon (France), National Museum of Art (Japan), Tate Modern (UK), Fundación ARCO (Spain), Kunsthaus Zürich (Switzerland) and Elgiz Museum (Turkey).
April 16, 2022

PİLEVNELİ is pleased to announce the representation of Ahmet Ertuğ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/140/
Snapshot: 20260512124147

Trained as an architect and having practiced professionally for many years in England, Iran, and Turkey, Ahmet Ertuğ began his photographic work in London in the early 1970s. Shaped by the discipline of architecture, his perspective gradually evolved into a distinctive photographic language focused on the silent presence of ancient structures, sacred spaces, and historical sculptures.
Ertuğ’s work spans a vast geography from Byzantine, Ottoman, Hellenistic, and Roman heritage to Japanese temples, Zen gardens, and ancient sculpture—approaching architecture and sculpture through a sense of timeless stillness. Created with a large-format camera, his photographs bring together scale, light, and material presence within a deeply contemplative atmosphere. With an exhibition history extending from Paris to Vienna, and from the Louvre Gardens to Hagia Sophia, Ertuğ’s work has been presented at major institutions including the Ephesos Museum in Vienna; Couvent des Cordeliers and La Conciergerie in Paris; the Musée Guimet; and the Bibliothèque Nationale de France. Alongside his internationally acclaimed art publications, the artist represents a unique practice that approaches photography as both a form of documentation and a meditative experience. His work will soon be on view at Le Stanze della Fotografia in Venice.
February 15, 2026
RELATED ARTIST
AHMET ERTUĞ

================================================================================
60 Minutes “AI Art: Revolutionary or Gimmick?” - REFİK ANADOL | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/141-60-minutes-ai-art-revolutionary-or-gimmick/
Snapshot: 20260516050121

AI: Revolutionary or Gimmick?
How is art created? A painter at a canvas, a photographer in the darkroom, a sculptor in the studio… But what if an artist is generating visuals using data and artificial intelligence?
This question is being debated today by some of the world’s most prestigious museums, critics, and auction houses. For some, AI represents a new turning point in art history; for others, it remains a field whose boundaries and responsibilities have yet to be clearly defined.
Refik Anadol stands at the center of this conversation as one of the pioneering figures in AI art. Featured on 60 Minutes in the segment
“AI Art: Revolutionary or Gimmick?”
, Anadol describes data as a pigment and algorithms as a “thinking brush.” In his practice, data is not merely a technical tool, but a fluid and evolving material with its own aesthetic potential. From photographs of the Earth to NASA archives and large-scale nature datasets, his work draws on vast sources of information.
Anadol’s production process is built on collaboration between human and machine. Artificial intelligence learns from extensive datasets, while the artist directs the system — selecting, curating, and making critical decisions. The resulting images belong neither entirely to the machine nor solely to the human.
In 2022,
Unsupervised
, exhibited at MoMA New York, was a monumental installation generated by an AI system trained on the metadata of the museum’s 200-year collection. Filling the museum’s lobby, the work transformed the collection’s digital memory into a continuously evolving visual flow. The piece held visitors’ attention for an unusually long time. Yet AI art is not without controversy. While some critics see it as a new language of expression, others raise questions around copyright, data sourcing, and ethical boundaries. Anadol’s position is clear: AI is not a threat, but a tool — provided it is grounded in ethical data practices and transparency.
Watch Refik Anadol’s 60 Minutes interview:
https://youtu.be/9LPV-hb1CKU?si=w7xyu983ZPOIi5s6
February 28, 2026
RELATED ARTIST
REFİK ANADOL

Nevin Aladağ Presents Public Resonator at PalaisPopulaire, Berlin | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/143-nevin-aladag-presents-public-resonator-at-palaispopulaire-berlin/
Snapshot: 20260512132429

PİLEVNELİ is pleased to announce Nevin Aladağ’s project presented within the exhibition
Public Resonator
at PalaisPopulaire.
Expanding the artist’s ongoing practice centered on sound, space, and collective experience, the work approaches public space as a resonant surface. Transforming the viewer from a passive observer into an active participant,
Public Resonator
enables the production of sound through various forms and materials, turning individual actions into part of a shared composition.
Through her interdisciplinary approach, Aladağ invites a reconsideration of concepts such as harmony and dissonance, as well as individual and collective experience, through the relationship she establishes between music, sculpture, and architecture. Shaped around questions of how public space is heard, experienced, and shared, the work unfolds as a structure that is continuously reconfigured through its interaction with the audience.
Public Resonator
is on view at PalaisPopulaire in Berlin through August 31, 2026.
April 24, 2026
RELATED ARTIST
NEVİN ALADAĞ

EAT ME: A Contemporary Opera by :mentalKLINIK Presented Across Europe | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/144-eat-me-a-contemporary-opera-by-mentalklinik-presented/
Snapshot: 20260613025546

EAT ME
, a contemporary opera developed by Oester, directed by Aïda Gabriëls, with scenography and spatial design by :mentalKLINIK, premiered on April 30 at Concertgebouw Brugge and was presented on May 8, 2026 at Elbphilharmonie in Hamburg.
In this project, :mentalKLINIK approached the stage not as a fixed backdrop, but as a constantly evolving environment that envelops the audience. As the opera unfolded within the installation, movement and choreography emerged from objects in use—and on the verge of use.
Audience members, performers, and musicians occupied the same spatial structure, dissolving the boundaries between observation and participation. This framework transformed the viewer into an active part of the experience.
EAT ME
rendered visible the ever-expanding, self-generating nature of desire through the interplay between space, body, and object.
May 15, 2026
RELATED ARTIST
:mentalKLINIK

================================================================================
Mehmet & Kazım’s new exhibition ON STAGE at Mount Analogue Studios | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/145-mehmet-kazms-new-exhibition-on-stage-at/
Snapshot: 20260613025033

PREVIOUS
Next
Mehmet & Kazım present their new works at ON STAGE at Mount Analogue Studios in Munich.
Extending their collaboration from public space into painting, installation, and performative forms, the duo proposes a new visual field through their large-scale, “almost abstract” paintings, challenging established readings of form, identity, and representation. Shaped by watercolor, collage, and fast, open-ended processes, the compositions allow forms to overlap, condense, and occasionally take on a sculptural presence.
Defined by a visual language of red and white, the works open up to humor, rupture, and contradiction, while foregrounding the collaborative nature of their practice. For Mehmet & Kazım, painting is less an individual expression than a shared mode of production, built through trust, exchange, and continuous dialogue.
ON STAGE can be visited from May 16 to May 29, 2026 at Mount Analogue Studios in Munich.
Photo: Kilian Blees
May 15, 2026
RELATED ARTIST
MEHMET & KAZIM

THE WORKS OF JOHAN CRETEN ARE IN PARIS DIOR! | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/15/
Snapshot: 20260615022603

PREVIOUS
Next
The works of Johan Creten are in Paris Dior, redesigned by Peter Marino!
Marino recreated the 2,000 square meter space, seeing it as a kind of theater stage or a set where many different plays can be performed. The space was designed with an interconnected series created with open spaces, design styles and inspirations from different periods. The gardens and interiors used by all parts of the brand include modern elements and materials, while at the same time, we are faced with a restored façade and classical wooden sills that refer to Dior's history. Furnitures of many famous designers such as Joaquim Tenreiro, Hans Olsen and Gio Ponti are accompanied by the works of artists such as Johan Creten, Jennifer Steinkamp, Guy Limone and Ina Genzken.
April 16, 2022
RELATED ARTIST
JOHAN CRETEN

REFİK ANADOL'S "INSPIRATION 4" NFT COLLECTION WAS SOLD FOR 6.2 MILLION US DOLLARS! | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/17/
Snapshot: 20260516054308

The sales of a limited number of NFTs created by Refik Anadol using the data of the "Inspiration4" space mission have been concluded. The entire collection sold for $6.2 million. US$2.5 million in sales revenue of the NFT collection, aligning with the purpose of the “Inspiration4” mission, goes to St. Jude's Children's Research Hospital. SpaceX space mission named “Inspiration4” is located in St. It took place in 2021 to raise funds for Jude's Children's and Research Hospital.
“Inspiration4” was the first civilian manned space flight in history, with no professional astronauts in its crew, completing a 3-day journey around the Earth's orbit. In order to raise awareness and raise funds, billionaire Jared Isaacman secured $100 million of the donation himself and donated a place for 3 people to join him in the space flight he financed. Jude's had raised $210 million in donations.
April 11, 2022
RELATED ARTIST
REFİK ANADOL

REFİK ANADOL'S AI DATA SCULPTURE TITLED "INDUSTRIAL DREAMS" IN HENRICHSHÜTTE HATTINGEN | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/18/
Snapshot: 20260614003254

Within the scope of the "Futur 21 - art industry culture" festival organized with the participation of 16 different industrial museums, LWL Industriemuseum in Hattingen, Germany included Refik Anadol's "Industrial Dreams". Within the scope of the festival, which aims to answer the questions about the future in historical regions, Refik Anadol's "Industrial Dreams" is exhibited on a 16-meter outdoor LED screen, hosted by LWL Industriemuseum. Visitors will be able to experience "Industrial Dreams" for the last time, which will be offered between 10 a.m. to 10 p.m. from March 12, 2022.
March 19, 2022

JOHAN CRETEN AT ROUBAIX LA PISCINE MUSEUM | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/19/
Snapshot: 20260516054005

Johan Creten, one of the artists from PILEVNELI, is carrying out an exhibition with Almine Rech Gallery at Roubaix La Piscine Museum. For this exhibition, in addition to two symbolic works from his career, C'est dans ma nature (2001) and De Vleermuis (2015-2019), the artist creates a monumental fountain in the shape of a bat and adorns it with seventeen unusual ceramic animal figures. The artist does not aim to create a still life work here, on the contrary, he states that everything is alive, pulsating and vibrating. The false naive monsters he creates describe the political essence of a world of conflict, struggle, and surrender, as well as joy, solace, and hope. The exhibition named Bestiarium can be visited between 12 March – 29 May 2022.
March 12, 2022
RELATED ARTIST
JOHAN CRETEN

BORA AKINCITÜRK'S FIRST SOLO EXHIBITION IN ENGLAND | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/20/
Snapshot: 20251110234308

One of the artists from PILEVNELI, Bora Akıncıtürk's first solo exhibition in England, titled "GROUP EGO DEATH YOGA AND MEDITATION", opened at Screw Gallery on 28 January. The gallery hosts four different exhibitions at the same time. This selection of Bora Akıncıtürk's new paintings, replacing one's self with a newer, more extreme self; symbolizes the attainment of a structured self consisting of aesthetics, managed by it. Space plays an important role in Akıncıtürk's works, recontextualizing images and objects within alternative structures to further complicate interpretation.
Bora Akıncıtürk's “GROUP EGO DEATH YOGA AND MEDITATION” exhibition can be visited between 28 January – 13 February 2022.
January 29, 2022
RELATED ARTIST
BORA AKINCITÜRK

URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/21/
Snapshot: 20260615014518

Hans Op De Beeck, one of the artists from PİLEVNELİ, is at the 16th Lyon Biennale!
Multi-disciplinary artist Op de Beeck, known for his monochrome sculptures and installations, will take part in the 16th Lyon Biennial, whose theme is "Manifesto of Fragility".
Sam Bardaouil and Till Fellrath are the curators of the biennial, which brings together 87 artists.
The 16th Lyon Biennial can be visited between 14 September - 31 December 2022 at the macLYON Art Museum, the old Fagor Factory and various venues in the city.

LADY DIOR BY JOHAN CRETEN | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/22/
Snapshot: 20260216091403

A sculpture that wears and transforms. Bringing a new breath to ceramics, Belgian-born artist Johan Creten recreates the Lady Dior bag for the sixth edition of Dior Lady Art. Creating designs with classic leather and fabrics for years, Lady Dior is now creating the Dior Lady Art 6 collection by blending art and desire. The introspection and humanistic conscience found in Creten's works are also a factor that guides this collaboration. "Love Games", one of the two creations, makes a reference to the earth with its soft and textured suede, while the motif of bees on it turns into a removable ornament. For Creten, bees symbolize the image of a positive society, being constructive and full of energy. The embroidery of the royal blue bag is another reflection of Dior Savoir Faire. Showcasing the transformation and rebirth of Lady Dior, this collection is available in limited numbers.
December 19, 2021
RELATED ARTIST
JOHAN CRETEN

URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/24/
Snapshot: 20260516054514

PILEVNELI is pleased to announce the representation of German artist Michael Sailstorfer!
Born in Velden, Germany in 1979, Michael Sailstorfer completed his art education at the Munich Fine Arts Academy and pursued his master degree at Goldsmiths University of London and graduated in 2004.
The artist lives and works in Berlin.
Works by Michael Sailstorfer are in the collections of many prestigious art institutions such as Center Pompidou (France), Fondazione Morra Greco (Italy), Jerry Speyer (USA), Leopold Hoesch Museum (Germany), Mariano Pichler Collection (Italy), MARTa Herford (Germany), MUSEION (Italy), Museum Kurhaus Kleve (Germany), Paolo Kind (England), Sammlung Boros (Germany), Sammlung Goetz (Germany), Städel Museum (Germany) and Walker Art Center (USA).

================================================================================
REFİK ANADOL'S "CASA BATLLÓ: LIVING ARCHITECTURE" AUCTION RESULTED WITH A SALE FOR 1 MILLION 380 THOUSAND DOLLARS | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/27-refik-anadol-s-casa-batllo-living-architecture-auction-resulted/
Snapshot: 20260614003031

Refik Anadol’s 1/1 dynamic NFT titled “Casa Batlló: Living Architecture” was auctioned in a 21st Century Evening Sale at Christie’s New York on May 10, 2022. The bidding resulted with a sale for 1 million 380 thousand US dollars.
Significant for being the first time a UNESCO world heritage site being part of an NFT, Refik Anadol, for the installation of “Casa Batlló: Living Architecture”, Refik Anadol utilizes the climate data and weather journal of the city of Barcelona, mapping the original work on the façade of Casa Batlló. The work is simultaneously being exhibited at Casa Batlló in Barcelona as of May 7, 2022. 10% of the proceeds from the auction sale are donated to the Associació Aprenem Autisme and Fundació Adana.
Refik Anadol’s 1/1 NFT immersive room installation “Machine Hallucinations - Space: Metaverse” was previously sold for 2 million 330 thousand US dollars at Sotheby’s Hong Kong in October 2021. A month later, “Machine Hallucinations: Coral Dreams” data painting was auctioned during Art Basel Miami Beach as a collaboration of Faena Art and Aorist and was sold for 851 thousand US dollars, whereas the same month, “Machine Hallucinations - Nature Dreams: AI Data Sculpture” data painting was sold for 1 million 184 thousand US dollars on OpenSea. Finally at the 21st Century Evening Sale at Christie’s New York “Casa Batlló: Living Architecture” has reached 1 million 380 thousand US dollars (including commission and taxes).
May 12, 2022
RELATED ARTIST
REFİK ANADOL

================================================================================
JOHAN CRETEN'S "WHY DOES STRANGE FRUIT ALWAYS LOOKS SO SWEET" IS AT SWEDISH HERITAGE MUSEUM | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/29/
Snapshot: 20260206221500

One of the iconic works of PILEVNELI artist Johan Creten, "Why Does Strange Fruit Always Looks So Sweet" is on display at the Swedish Pilane Heritage Museum. The work, which will be exhibited outdoors, reveals the integration of nature and art.
While living in the Mexican desert, in the Nuevo Léon region, to work with local artisans, Johan Creten fall sick because he overworked. As he watches the fruits outside from where he lies, the image of the fruit and the infected glands got mixed in his mind, causing him to hallucinate. Inspired by this experience, Johan Creten, produces multiple versions of his sculpture "Why Does Strange Fruit Always Looks So Sweet?", both with glazed ceramic and bronze.
The work has previously been exhibited in many prestigious art institutions such as Salon Perrotin Matignon, CRAC, Villa Datris, Jardin Exotique de Monaco.
May 19, 2022
RELATED ARTIST
JOHAN CRETEN

================================================================================
HANS OP DE BEECK IS UNDERTAKING THE DIRECTING, SCENOGRAPHY AND COSTUME DESIGN OF THE OPERA TITLED "THE CONVERT" | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/31-hans-op-de-beeck-is-undertaking-the-directing/
Snapshot: 20250521215342

PILEVNELI artist Hans Op de Beck is undertaking the directing, scenography and costume design of the opera titled "The Convert", composed by Wim Henderickx for the libretto of Krystian Lada.
With Vigdis Adelaïs, Hertmans creates a strong woman torn between two religions, at the end of the 11th century during the First Crusade, she was raised as a Christian but became Jewish for her love. "The Convert" tells the tragic story of a young mother, who was the victim of a pogrom in times of religious violence, searching for her abducted children.
Henderickx's compositions are unique in finding a bridge between musical languages. In his score, influences from Western early music, modernism and film music merge in a symbiotic way with both Jewish and Arab traditions to create a contemporary opera in which Vigdis' epic life story is told through sound.
Opera Ballet Vlaanderen Symphony Orchestra under the baton of Koen Kessels is played by soprano Lore Binon.
Director and visual artist Hans Op de Beeck, who is also responsible for the scenography and costume design, creates a poetic visual world in which Vigdis' quest takes centre stage in a bygone world that is astonishingly similar to ours.
"The Convert" can be viewed from 10th May to 4th June 2022 at the Opera Ballet Vlaanderen, Antwerp.
May 18, 2022
PREVIOUS
|
Next

of 95

In his score, influences from Western early music, modernism and film music merge in a symbiotic way with both Jewish and Arab traditions to create a contemporary opera in which Vigdis' epic life story is told through sound.
Opera Ballet Vlaanderen Symphony Orchestra under the baton of Koen Kessels is played by soprano Lore Binon.
Director and visual artist Hans Op de Beeck, who is also responsible for the scenography and costume design, creates a poetic visual world in which Vigdis' quest takes centre stage in a bygone world that is astonishingly similar to ours.
"The Convert" can be viewed from 10th May to 4th June 2022 at the Opera Ballet Vlaanderen, Antwerp.
May 18, 2022

REFİK ANADOL'S "RUMİ'S DREAMS" AT ATATÜRK CULTURAL CENTER | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/32/
Snapshot: 20251214195538

Refik Anadol's new installation titled "Rumi's Dreams" is available to experience at Atatürk Cultural Center from 28 May 2022.
“Rumi's Dreams” benefits from the Mevlana archives of Refik Anadol Studio with the support of Konya Metropolitan Municipality. Refik Anadol Studio, as a result of long-term archival studies, creates a poetic, gripping and multi-sensory work of art to commemorate Mevlana on the 750th anniversary of his death. "Rumi's Dreams", which was created by making the translation of the Mesnevi in ​​19 languages ​​'read' by artificial intelligence, thus brings together the projection of the Mevlana archive created in the memory of a machine with the visitor. Anadol and his team are innovating with this project using DALL-E 2, a cutting-edge neural network and converter model that extracts images from text in collaboration with OpenAI. The resulting data universe becomes the building block of machine-generated Rumi-themed dreams that allow one to feel Mevlana's poetic universe at an augmented scale.
“Rumi's Dreams” can be experienced at Atatürk Cultural Center until 12 June 2022 as part of the Beyoğlu Municipality Culture Road.
June 9, 2022
RELATED ARTIST
REFİK ANADOL

“Sense of Healing”, donated to the auction by @myndcenters, a newly established company in collaboration with neuroscience pioneer @minmaze.labs and one of the leading organizations in the health industry, Therme Group @thermeartprogram, will be on sale in Capri on July 30.

HANS OP DE BEECK'S NEW EXHIBITION "THE QUIET PARADE" | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/38/
Snapshot: 20260312073307

Hans Op de Beeck's new exhibition "The Quiet Parade" will be seen by the visitors from September 21, 2022 at Amos Rex.
Life, death and memories are among the recurring themes in the works of the Belgian artist, who traps the viewer in an ordinary moment from daily life and directs them to questions about existence with his sculptures and installations that envelop the space. With the exhibition “The Quiet Parade”, Op de Beeck draws a mind map of sculptures for visitors. The exhibition, which includes the sculptures produced by the artist between 2015-2022, creates a fiction that describes different parts of life. The gray landscapes, which seem to be covered with ashes, invite visitors to slow down, embark on an inner journey and focus on the moment.
At the opening of the “The Quiet Parade” exhibition, Op de Beeck's film titled “Staging Silence (3)” will also be screened as part of the Helsinki International Film Festival. The exhibition can be visited until February 26, 2023.
September 21, 2022

DEFNE TESAL'S SITE-SPECIFIC INSTALLATION AT MEŞHER | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/39/
Snapshot: 20260206232243

One of the Pilevneli artists Defne Tesal's site-specific installation "I'm Nobody. Are You Nobody?" is meeting with its visitors in Meşher. The exhibition, which will open on September 14, 2022, is based on the unrequited love story of Echo and Narcissus in Ancient Greek mythology. The exhibition interprets the reflection, resonance and metamorphosis themes presented by this narrative in the light of today's artistic and social dynamics. Curated by Selen Ansen, the exhibition features nearly 120 works by 44 artists from Turkey and abroad. Named after Emily Dickinson's "I Am Nobody! Who are you?" Inspired by his poetry, the exhibition invites visitors to a space where relationships are woven between countless you(s), me(s), desires, narratives, images and experiences. The exhibition, which can be seen until February 12, 2023, can be visited free of charge from Tuesday to Sunday between 11:00 and 19:00.
September 15, 2022

PREVIOUS
Next
A two-volume book, “Night Diary” by Jan Fabre, who is also renowned as an author, will be published simultaneously with the exhibition, with collaboration of PILEVNELI and Doğan Kitap. Serving as an autobiography of Fabre, the book contains notes dated between 1978-1984 and 1985-1991, written on art, life, daily life and relationships.
Founder of the theater company Troubleyn in 1986, Jan Fabre’s one-man play “Night Writer”, based on different volumes of his evolving “Night Diary” has been on stage in many countries such as Italy, Russia, France, Serbia, Belgium, Lithuania, Croatia, Slovenia and has won already 3 important theater awards. The artist’s solo theater/ dance production “Angel of Death”, on the other hand, has met with theater enthusiasts in 2006 within the scope of the 15th Istanbul International Theater Festival and the 4th Theater Olympics.

================================================================================
MEHMET&KAZIM AKA "KISSING COUSINS" ARE ON THE THEATRE STAGE | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/42-mehmet-kazim-aka-kissing-cousins-are-on-the-theatre/
Snapshot: 20251205084817

Mehmet & Kazım, one of the artists from PİLEVNELİ, are designing the stage for Emre Akal's play named Göttersimulation, which was on show at Munich Kammerspiele. The play, which premiered on November 5, 2022, explores the relationships between the analog and digital age, seeks new and old experts from both worlds, and questions the failures between these worlds. The team, consisting of stage and costume designers Paula Wellmann, Mehmet&Kazim and Annika Lu Hermann, collaborate to create a visual language between analog and virtual reality, inspired by the visual worlds of the artist duo Mehmet&Kazim. In the play, eight young actors meet Erkin Akal and Walter Hess and show the last two people left in the analog world the endless promises of the digital world. Göttersimulation can be seen until December 23, 2022 and the next season.
Mehmet & Kazım PİLEVNELİ held their first solo exhibition between March 3 and April 9, 2022.
Photo: Armin Smailovic
November 11, 2022

MEHMET & KAZIM

================================================================================
REFIK ANADOL'S NEW EXHIBITION AT MUSEUM OF MODERN ART, NEW YORK | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/43/
Snapshot: 20260511115738

The exhibition, which reinterprets MoMA's archive of more than 200 years with the help of artificial intelligence and transforms it into works of visual art, will open on November 19, 2022 in MoMA, New York. The exhibition titled “REFIK ANADOL: UNSUPERVISED” will continue until March 5, 2023.
The organization and curation of the exhibition, which includes three major works, including the 24x24m LED wall on the ground floor of the museum, is carried out by Michelle Kuo, Paola Antonelli and Lydia Mullin. Michelle Kuo, Curator of Marlene Hess Painting and Sculpture Department, thinks that this exhibition will “reform the relationship between the physical and the virtual, the real and the imaginary”. Paola Antonelli, Chief Curator of the Architecture and Design Department and Director of Research and Development, says that the Refik Anadol project is proof of this innovative vision of the museum.
In the online exhibition held on FeralFile in 2021, Refik Anadol used visual data from MoMA's public archive, an advanced machine learning model to produce works that continuously and in real time create new, surreal images. The entire 'MoMA: Unsupervised' series, which reinterprets the history of modern art with the journey of artificial intelligence in the MoMA archive, will be exhibited in New York as of November 19, 2022.
November 11, 2022
RELATED ARTIST
REFİK ANADOL

================================================================================
WORKS BY ARIK LEVY AND ZOE OUVRIER AT MUSEE BARBIER-MUELLER | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/44/
Snapshot: 20251005195559

In the exhibition titled 'Invisible Thoughts', Arik Levy and Zoe Ouvrier create a selection of historical artifacts from the Musée Barbier-Mueller collection and establish relationships with their own contemporary works. Zoe Ouvrier, for the interesting dialogues that ensued, says that “the mystical relationship created by the material attracts her attention, she connects her works with her emotions without comparing herself to African artists and craftsmen”.
Arik Levy, on the other hand, sees the “invisible thoughts” that give the exhibition its name as part of daily life, social, collective and personal behaviors. According to Levy, invisible thoughts activate deep thoughts and connect with works, artists and audiences.
'Invisible Thoughts' will host art lovers at Musée Barbier-Mueller in Geneva between 9 November 2022 and 3 September 2023.
November 11, 2022
RELATED ARTIST
ARIK LEVY

"AN OBJECT NEVER COMES ALONE" BY DANIEL FIRMAN | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/46/
Snapshot: 20260614013501

Daniel Firman's new exhibition titled “An object never comes alone” is at Ceysson Benetiere Lyon. In the exhibition, previously unexhibited works of Firman from the “Mini-gathering” series will be presented.
Works from the "Gathering" series, which he started to produce for the first time in the early 2000s, were presented to art lovers in PİLEVNELİ Mecidiyeköy at the "10 Artists / 10 Individual Practices" exhibition in 2018. The series, which the artist developed and changed over time, was shown at the "Plastic Confetti" exhibition held in Ceysson Benetiere New York in 2019, and then at the "Wall Dancing" exhibition in PİLEVNELİ Mandarin Oriental, Bodrum in the summer of 2021.
Opening today, “An object never comes alone” will welcome visitors to Lyon until 17 December 2022.

================================================================================
PILEVNELI is pleased to announce the representation of Yuşa Yalçıntaş! | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/49/
Snapshot: 20260516050425

Yuşa Yalçıntaş, who was born on 19 August 1985 in Istanbul, began his education in the Department of Fine Arts of Marmara University in 2005. He completed his education in 2011, after studying the Printing Department at the Faculty of Fine Arts in Finland between 2009-2010.The artistic language he built following the drawing rules he created himself; blends elements from nostalgic children's book illustrations, the relationship between games & rituals, and the modern Turkish education system after the Republic. Since his works only contain children in a non-linear perspective, they have a 'surreal' viewpoint similar to that of miniature, Far Eastern painting, or Medieval Western art. The artist's works, in his own words, which are 'artificial stages', offer the audience an enigmatic theater.Yuşa Yalçıntaş lives and works in İstanbul.
January 31, 2023

PILEVNELI is pleased to announce the representation of Yuşa Yalçıntaş! | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/49-pilevneli-is-pleased-to-announce-the-representation-of/
Snapshot: 20260615011332

Yuşa Yalçıntaş, who was born on 19 August 1985 in Istanbul, began his education in the Department of Fine Arts of Marmara University in 2005. He completed his education in 2011, after studying the Printing Department at the Faculty of Fine Arts in Finland between 2009-2010.The artistic language he built following the drawing rules he created himself; blends elements from nostalgic children's book illustrations, the relationship between games & rituals, and the modern Turkish education system after the Republic. Since his works only contain children in a non-linear perspective, they have a 'surreal' viewpoint similar to that of miniature, Far Eastern painting, or Medieval Western art. The artist's works, in his own words, which are 'artificial stages', offer the audience an enigmatic theater.Yuşa Yalçıntaş lives and works in İstanbul.
January 31, 2023

He completed his education in 2011, after studying the Printing Department at the Faculty of Fine Arts in Finland between 2009-2010.The artistic language he built following the drawing rules he created himself; blends elements from nostalgic children's book illustrations, the relationship between games & rituals, and the modern Turkish education system after the Republic. Refik Anadol "Makine Hatıraları: Uzay" / Refik Anadol "Machine Memoirs: Space" | PILEVNELI
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/5/
Snapshot: 20210319140201

Share
Facebook
Twitter
Pinterest
Tumblr
Email
“Makine Hatıraları: Uzay”, 18 Mart’ta gerçekleşecek ve davetiyeyle gezilebilecek ön izlemenin ardından, 19 Mart itibarıyla pazar hariç her gün 10.00-18.00 saatleri arasında ücretsiz olarak izlenebilecek. Covid-19 tedbirleri dolayısıyla hafta sonu kısıtlamalarında değişiklik olması durumunda sergi pazartesi hariç her gün 10.00-18.00 arasında gezilebilecek.
Sergiye Gelmeden Önce:
• Sergi 9 yaşın üzerindeki çocuklar için tavsiye edilir. Bireysel ziyaretlerde 15 yaşından küçük çocuklara bir yetişkinin eşlik etmesi gerekmektedir.
• Sergiye gelmeden önce HES kodunuzu karekod olarak hazırlamanızı rica ederiz.
• Serginin bir bölümünün galoşla gezilmesi gerekmetedir. Tercihen siyah renkte olması istenen galoşları dilerseniz yanınızda getirebilir veya galeri ekibinden ücret karşılığı temin edebilirsiniz.
• Sergiyi gezerken galoş giyileceği için ziyaretçilerin topuklu ayakkabıyla gelmemesi tavsiye edilir.
• Ziyaretçiler Covid-19 tedbirleri dolayısıyla galerinin kapasitesine göre içeri alınacaktır. İçerideki kişi sayısının maksimum kapasitede olması durumunda ziyaretçiler galerinin dışarısına bekleyebilirler.
• Galerinin her alanı pandemi tedbirleri çerçevesinde düzenli olarak temizlenmektedir. Açılış öncesi, gün içerisinde ve kapanış sonrasında rutin temizleme işlemleri devam etmektedir.
• Düzenli olarak sağlık kontrolünden geçen ve her gün ateşleri ölçülen galeri çalışanları, sizleri gerekli koruyucu ekipmanlarla karşılayacaktır.
• Sergi mekanında vestiyer alanı bulunmamaktadır. PİLEVNELİ, ziyaretçilerin şahsi eşyalarıyla ilgili hiçbir sorumluluğu kabul etmez.
• Ziyaretçilerin galeri mekanına dışardan yiyecek ve içecek getirmesi yasaktır.
• Galeri girişimiz engelli misafirlerimizin ziyaretine uygun koşullardadır.
• Sergideki eserler üç boyutlu olup, güçlü ışık efektleri ile yüksek ses içerir. Işık ve ses efektlerine duyarlılığı bulunan ziyaretçilerimizin rahatsız olabileceği göz önünde bulundurulmalıdır. PİLEVNELİ, bu serginin ziyaretçi tarafından deneyimlenmesinden ve kullanılmasından dolayı ne açıkça ne de zımnen hiçbir sorumluluk kabul etmemektedir.
• Sergi detaylı bir teknoloji gerektirdiği için beklenmedik zamanlarda bakım ihtiyacı doğabilir ve buna bağlı olarak sergi girişlerinde gecikmeler veya iptaller yaşanabilir.
Sergi Kuralları :
• Galeriye HES kodunuzla girebilirsiniz.
• Girişte ateş ölçümü yaptırmak pandemi kuralları çerçevesinde zorunludur.
• Galeride ziyaretçilerin kolaylıkla ulaşabileceği dezenfeksiyon noktaları bulunmaktadır.
• Pandemi kuralları çerçevesinde galeri mekanına girecek her ziyaretçinin maskeli olması gerekmektedir. Sergi ziyareti sırasında ziyaretçilerimizin kısa süreli de olsa, fotoğraf çekerken dahi maskelerini çıkarmaları yasaktır.
• Pandemi tedbirleri nedeniyle mekan içerisinde belirli sayıda ziyaretçi ağırlayabildiğimiz için, sergi ziyaret süresi ortalama 1 saattir. Galerinin içinde bu sürenin çok üstünde vakit geçiren ziyaretçilerin galeri ekibi tarafından gezilerini tamamlamaları rica edilebilir.
• Mekan içinde sergiyi gezen, mekan dışında sıra bekleyen ziyaretçilerin sosyal mesafe kurallarına dikkat etmesi gerekmektedir.
• Pandemi dolayısıyla galeri mekanındaki tuvaletler ziyaretçi kullanımına kapalıdır.
• Sergi alanında koşmak, zıplamak, alandaki eserlere, donanım ve kurulumlara dokunmak veya zarar vermek güvenlik gereği kesinlikle yasaktır.
• Sergide fotoğraf ve video çekimi flaşsız ve tripodsuz bir şekilde yapılabilir. Profesyonel amaçlı (reklam, tanıtım vb.) fotoğraf ve video çekimi kesinlikle yasaktır. Bu tip kullanımlar durumunda telif haklarına ilişkin düzenlemeler doğrultusunda işlem yapılacaktır.
• Ziyaretçilerin sergi alanında çekilen fotoğraflarının tüm hakları PİLEVNELİ’de saklıdır. Ayrıca PİLEVNELİ, ziyaretçilerin sergi alanında çekmiş ve paylaşmış olduğu fotoğraf ve videolar üzerinde hak sahibidir.
“Makine Hatıraları: Uzay”, İstanbul Büyükşehir Belediyesi’nin özel desteğiyle; Borusan Otomotiv’in Türkiye distribütörü olduğu BMW, İBB iştiraklerinden Kültür AŞ ve Samsung Galaxy S21 Serisi ana sponsorluğunda hayata geçiyor. Beyoğlu Belediyesi’nin de destek verdiği serginin katılımcı sponsorları ABC Deterjan, Atelier Rebul, Fuudy, Jotun, Kahve Dünyası Algötür, MG International Fragrance Company, Swissôtel The Bosphorus Istanbul; medya sponsoru Joy FM; reklam ve tanıtım sponsorları ise City’s, IstanbulArtNews, Just Work, Kentvizyon, Panoffect ve Panout.
After a private preview on March 18, 2021, Refik Anadol's new solo exhibition “Machine Memoirs: Space” will be open for visitors free of charge on and after March 19, 2021 between 10.00-18.00 excluding Sundays at PILEVNELI Dolapdere. In case there are changes affecting the Covid-19 precautions regarding weekend curfews, the exhibition will be open everyday between 10.00-18.00 excluding Mondays.
Before Coming to the Exhibition:
• The exhibition is recommended for children over the age of 9. In individual visits it is recommended that an adult assists children under the age of 15.
• Please prepare your HES code as a QR code prior to the exhibition.
• Part of the exhibition can only be visited with galosh. Please either bring (preferably black) galosh along or you can purchase a pair at the entrance.
• As galosh is used throughout the exhibition, we don’t advise wearing high heels in the gallery.
• The visitors are admitted according to the Covid-19 measures. If the gallery capacity is in maximum, the visitors are asked to wait outside.
• The gallery is cleaned thoroughly regularly for the Covid-19 measures. Cleaning proceeds every day before the opening, throughout the day, and after the closing.
• The gallery staff goes through a Covid checkup on a regular basis will provide the visitors with necessary health accessories.
• The gallery doesn’t have a coat check. PILEVNELI doesn’t take any responsibility in any personal belongings.
• The visitors cannot bring any food or drinks to the gallery.
• The gallery entrance is available for disabled guests.
• Art pieces in the exhibition are three-dimensional works, and contains light effects and powerful sound. Visitors who have sensitivity to light and sound should be mindful of it prior to coming to the exhibition.
• As the exhibition contains a very detailed technology, at unexpected times there might be need of maintenance; for this reason delays or cancellations might occur.
Exhibition Rules :
• Visitors must show their HES code upon entry.
• Measuring the temperature as entering tol the gallery is mandatory because of the pandemic.
• There are disinfection points for visitors to reach easily.
• For the pandemic measures, each visitor entering to the gallery has to wear a mask. Our visitors cannot take out their masks thoughout the exhibition, even for a photo.
• As for the pandemic measures, the gallery can host only a limited number of people in the gallery, and visiting hour for each visitor is an hour. Visitors that spend beyond this time will be assisted out by our staff.
• Visitors who are both in the gallery and outside in the queue should mind social distancing.
• As for the pandemic, the bathrooms in the gallery are closed.
• Running and jumping in the gallery, touching and damaging the art works in the gallery are strictly forbidden.
• Photography only without flash and tripod is allowed in the gallery. Filming and photographing for professional shoots are strongly prohibited. For unauthorized uses, the gallery will seek authors royalties.
• All rights of the photos taken in the exhibition are reserved to PILEVNELI. Further, PILEVNELI, contains all the rights to the photos taken by the visitors through the exhibition.
“Machine Memoirs: Space” is realized with the special support of Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality and is sponsored by BMW distributed by Borusan Otomotiv in Turkey, IMM subsidiary Kültür AŞ and Samsung Galaxy S21 Series. Also supported by Beyoğlu Municipality, the exhibition’s contributors are ABC Deterjan, Atelier Rebul, Fuudy, Jotun, Kahve Dünyası Algötür, MG International Fragrance Company, Swissôtel the Bosphorus Istanbul, its media sponsor is Joy FM and its advertisement and publicity sponsors are City’s, IstanbulArtNews, Just Work, Kentvizyon, Panoffect and Panout.
March 3, 2021

We updated our working hours due to the curfew restrictions taken due to Covid-19.  From April 14, 2021, Refik Anadol's "Machine Memories: Space" exhibition will be open at PİLEVNELİ Dolapdere between 09.00 - 17.00 excluding Saturdays and Sundays.
Before Coming to the Exhibition:
•
The exhibition is visited free of charge and without appointment.
• The visitors are admitted according to the Covid-19 measures. If the gallery capacity is in maximum, the visitors are asked to wait outside. We kindly ask visitors outside the gallery to pay attention to the 1.5 meter rule.
• Based on our experiences so far, we would like to explain that we have developed a new application for our visitors: It is very difficult for the visitors after the 200th person waiting in line at 15:00 to enter the exhibition. Therefore, our colleagues on duty at the specified hour warn our visitors after the 200th person in the queue that they should not wait verbally. We wish you to heed this warning. The 200th person we mentioned will definitely be taken to the gallery no matter what time it is.
• The exhibition is recommended for children over the age of 9. In individual visits it is recommended that an adult assists children under the age of 15.
• Please prepare your HES code as a QR code prior to the exhibition.
• The exhibition can only be visited with galosh. Please either bring galosh along or you can purchase a pair at the entrance.
• As galosh is used throughout the exhibition, we don’t advise wearing high heels in the gallery.
• The gallery is cleaned thoroughly regularly for the Covid-19 measures. Cleaning proceeds every day before the opening, throughout the day, and after the closing.
• The gallery staff goes through a Covid checkup on a regular basis will provide the visitors with necessary health accessories.
• The gallery doesn’t have a coat check. PILEVNELI doesn’t take any responsibility in any personal belongings.
• The visitors cannot bring any food or drinks to the gallery.
• The gallery entrance is available for disabled guests.
• The works in this exhibition are three-dimensional and contain flashing light/color effects and loud sounds. They may cause discomfort to children and adults with sensitivity. People diagnosed with photosensitive epilepsy, or have a history of seizures should be especially careful. Waiver discretion is advised.
• As the exhibition contains a very detailed technology, at unexpected times there might be need of maintenance; for this reason delays or cancellations might occur.
Exhibition Rules :
• Visitors must show their HES code upon entry.
• Measuring the temperature as entering tol the gallery is mandatory because of the pandemic.
• There are disinfection points for visitors to reach easily.
• For the pandemic measures, each visitor entering to the gallery has to wear a mask. Our visitors cannot take out their masks thoughout the exhibition, even for a photo. If you want to change your mask, you can get it free of charge from the gallery.
• As for the pandemic measures, the gallery can host only a limited number of people in the gallery, and visiting hour for each visitor is an hour. Visitors that spend beyond this time will be assisted out by our staff.
• Visitors who are both in the gallery and outside in the queue should mind social distancing.
• As for the pandemic, the bathrooms in the gallery are closed.
• Running and jumping in the gallery, touching and damaging the art works in the gallery are strictly forbidden.
• Photography only without flash and tripod is allowed in the gallery. Filming and photographing for professional shoots are strongly prohibited. For unauthorized uses, the gallery will seek authors royalties.
• All rights of the photos taken in the exhibition are reserved to PILEVNELI. Further, PILEVNELI, contains all the rights to the photos taken by the visitors through the exhibition.
“Machine Memoirs: Space” is realized with the special support of Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality and is sponsored by BMW distributed by Borusan Otomotiv in Turkey, IMM subsidiary Kültür AŞ and Samsung Galaxy S21 Series. Also supported by Beyoğlu Municipality, the exhibition’s contributors are ABC Deterjan, Atelier Rebul, Fuudy, Jotun, Kahve Dünyası Algötür, MG International Fragrance Company, Swissôtel the Bosphorus Istanbul, its media sponsor is Joy FM and its advertisement and publicity sponsors are City’s, IstanbulArtNews, Just Work, Kentvizyon, Panoffect and Panout.

Covid-19 tedbirleri gereği alınan sokağa çıkma kısıtlaması nedeniyle çalışma saatlerimizi güncelledik. 14 Nisan 2021 itibarıyla  Refik Anadol 'un “Makine Hatıraları: Uzay” sergisi haftaiçi her gün 09.00 - 17.00 saatleri arasında PİLEVNELİ Dolapdere'de açık olacak.
Sergiye Gelmeden Önce:
•
Sergi ücretsiz ve randevusuz gezilmektedir.
• Ziyaretçiler Covid-19 tedbirleri dolayısıyla galerinin kapasitesine göre içeri alınacaktır. İçerideki kişi sayısının maksimum kapasitede olması durumunda ziyaretçiler galerinin dışarısına bekleyebilirler. Galerinin dışındaki ziyaretçilerin 1.5 metre kuralına özen göstermelerini rica ediyoruz.
• Şu ana kadar yaşadığımız tecrübelere dayanarak ziyaretçilerimiz için yeni bir uygulama geliştirdiğimizi açıklamak isteriz: Saat 15:00 itibarıyla sırada bekleyen ziyaretçilerimizden 200. kişiden sonrakilerin sergiye girebilmesi çok zor. Dolayısıyla belirttiğimiz saatte görevli arkadaşlarımız sırada bulunan 200. kişiden sonraki ziyaretçilerimize sözlü olarak beklememeleri gerektiği konusunda uyarıda bulunuyor. Bu uyarıyı dikkate almanızı diliyoruz. Bahsini ettiğimiz 200. kişi ise saat kaç olursa olsun muhakkak galeriye alınacaktır.
•
Serginin açık olduğu her gün 09.00 - 11.00 saatleri arasında 65 yaş üstü, engelli ve hamile ziyaretçilerimize ve bir refakatçilerine giriş önceliği tanınacaktır.

“Machine Memoirs: Space” is realized with the special support of Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality and is sponsored by BMW distributed by Borusan Otomotiv in Turkey, IMM subsidiary Kültür AŞ and Samsung Galaxy S21 Series. Also supported by Beyoğlu Municipality, the exhibition’s contributors are ABC Deterjan, Atelier Rebul, Fuudy, Jotun, Kahve Dünyası Algötür, MG International Fragrance Company, Swissôtel the Bosphorus Istanbul, its media sponsor is Joy FM and its advertisement and publicity sponsors are City’s, IstanbulArtNews, Just Work, Kentvizyon, Panoffect and Panout.
March 31, 2021

Snapshot: 20260311042630

The artist collective and creative studio Sucuk & Bratwurst, founded in 2014 by Denis Olgac, Lukas Olgac, Alessandro Belliero and David Gönner, consists mainly of moving and stable three-dimensional and digital works. The four, who are childhood friends, began their creative work together with the blog they established in 2012. The photographs, collages, traditional drawings and three-dimensional works they shared in their blog began to draw attention and Sucuk & Bratwurst began to receive invitations to individual and group expositions. With the establishment of the creative agency in 2014, they began to do design and commercial works. The commercial projects they executed include Alexander Wang, Rimowa, Moncler, Nike, Adidas, Porche, Converse, Dior, and Converse. Sucuk & Bratwurst has also worked with established artists such as Lena Meyer-Landrut, Post Malone and Dua Lipa.

ERWIN OLAF AND HANS OP DE BEECK AT THE NATIONAL MUSEUM OF HISTORY AND ART, LUXEMBOURG | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/51/
Snapshot: 20260421174452

Dutch photographer Erwin Olaf and Belgian multi-disciplinary artist Hans Op de Beeck are collaborating on a project for the first time thanks to their mutual admiration for Edward Steichen. In the exhibition organized to commemorate the 50th anniversary of Steichen’s death, his landscape photographs are accompanied by Olaf's series "Im Wald" and Op de Beeck's sculpture, watercolor and video works. The exhibition encourages visitors to rediscover Steichen by looking at him from a contemporary perspective, presented by two contemporary artists who were inspired by him. The exhibition titled “Erwin Olaf & Hans Op de Beeck: Inspired by Steichen”, will host art lovers at Le Musée National d'Histoire et d’Art in Luxembourg from December 16, 2022 to June 11, 2023.

REFIK ANADOL SIGNED A NEW PIECE FOR THE 53RD WORLD ECONOMIC FORUM | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/53/
Snapshot: 20260613034141

The artwork created specifically for the event consists of an artificial intelligence interpretation of almost 1 billion coral photographs. Integrating nature with a digital data ecosystem, the work aims to help metaverse and blockchain economies tackle global climate change issues. “Artificial Realities: Coral” used one of the most complex artificial intelligence, producing the closest artificial version of real corals and providing a multi-sensory experience to the viewers with the smell of the ocean.Refik Anadol is one of the two names from Turkey who participated as a speaker at this year's World Economic Forum. Anadol's speech, titled "Cultural Leaders as a Catalyst of Change" and the AI panel where the artist was also a panelist took place on 17 January 2023.

PILEVNELI is pleased to announce the representation of :mentalKLINIK! | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/57/
Snapshot: 20260614013737

Photography by Janarbek Amankulo
PİLEVNELİ is pleased to announce the representation of :mentalKLINIK, the artist duo founded by Yasemin Baydar and Birol Demir in 1998.
Working between Istanbul and Brussels, :mentalKLINIK functions as a multimedia and conceptual laboratory where the mind and practice intersect—”:mental” reflecting thought and “KLINIK” signifying action. Their work engages with contemporary objects using them to reveal underlying behavioral, psychological, political, and emotional dynamics. Their practice, like the world around us, is at once seductive and disquieting, shifting between the glamorous and the unsettling. Since their inception, :mentalKLINIK has continuously evolved, moving beyond conventional distinctions of spirit, body, and genre to forge a more fluid and inclusive artistic identity.
:mentalKLINIK is preparing to present their first solo exhibition and monograph with the PİLEVNELİ Gallery in December 2025.
October 14, 2024
RELATED ARTIST
:mentalKLINIK

PILEVNELI is pleased to announce the representation of RASİM AKSAN | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/58/
Snapshot: 20260614005012

PİLEVNELİ is pleased to announce the representation of Rasim Aksan!
Born in 1984 in Osmancık, Rasim Aksan explores the depths of human relationships, space, and visual perception through a figurative and hyper-realistic style. By blending classical references with contemporary themes, Aksan confronts the viewer with a layered visual world where the past and present intertwine. He invites the audience to move beyond being passive observers. Combining acrylic, calligraphy ink, and marbling paint with airbrush techniques, he creates highly sophisticated and detailed compositions regardless of scale.
The artist is preparing to present his first solo exhibition and monograph under the PİLEVNELİ Gallery in September 2025.
October 11, 2024

PILEVNELI is pleased to announce the representation of BANU ANKA | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/59/
Snapshot: 20260311135953

PİLEVNELİ is pleased to announce the representation of Banu Anka!
Banu Anka was born in Iran. She earned her BFA in Painting at Tehran University of Art in 2009. She studied “Painting and Art History” at Toronto ACS Academy in 2013, and got her MFA in painting at Yeditepe University 2018 where she wrote her thesis under the supervision of Ergin İnan. Anka’s figurative works mostly contain human figures drawn with a hyper realistic technique. She puts emphasis on the eyes of the figures and their looks. The hyperrealism in her work is accompanied by abstract elements.
From 2009 to 2014, she participated in various exhibitions in Tehran, and won Iran’s Art For Peace Festival Award in 2015. She moved from Iran to Istanbul in 2013. Banu Anka lives and works in Istanbul.
October 18, 2024
RELATED ARTIST
BANU ANKA

PİLEVNELİ is taking part in the 5th edition of Enter Art Fair in Copenhagen.
PİLEVNELİ, which presents a selection of Tarık Töre’s works at Enter Art Fair, can be visited at booth number 69 between August 24-27, 2023. Enter Art Fair, one of the largest international art fairs in Northern Europe, is held in Copenhagen and brings together 88 of the world’s leading galleries from 22 countries and 36 cities.
The 5th edition of Enter Art Fair takes place in Lokomotivværkstedet, one of Copenhagen’s liveliest cultural venues.
The 10,000 m2 historical venue was used for the maintenance of Danish locomotives and is known for its industrial architecture and symbolic green color.
August 24, 2023

Nevin Aladağ won the 2026 Kurt Schwitters Award. | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/61/
Snapshot: 20260613030328

Berlin-based artist Nevin Aladağ has been awarded the 2026 Kurt Schwitters Prize by the Lower Saxony Savings Bank Foundation.
Known for her work on themes of cultural identity and social diversity, Aladağ first gained international recognition at Documenta 14 and the Venice Biennale. Currently a professor of “Sculpture in Motion” at the Dresden University of Fine Arts, she expressed admiration for Schwitters, noting his unique blend of humor and seriousness as a major influence on her own work.
Congratulations to Aladağ on this well-deserved honor!

Snapshot: 20260311122253

PİLEVNELİ is pleased to announce its representation of Lal Batman!
Born in 2001 in Bursa, Lal Batman explores how people perceive art by blending figurative and conceptual styles. Her works focus on the interaction between space, the viewer, and the artwork, reflecting the transition from traditional to intellectual art. Having participated in international projects across Europe, Asia, South America, and the Balkans, the artist invites audiences to experience her art on a deeper level. Using diverse materials, she creates intricate compositions that push the boundaries of traditional art.

================================================================================
Refik Anadol created a special work for Akbank that explores the bank's historical journey. | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/63/
Snapshot: 20260311132140

Refik Anadol created a special work for Akbank that explores the bank's historical journey.
The artwork is notable for being Turkey's first permanent artificial intelligence artwork. It consists of four sections: Akbank Archives, Akbank Memories, Istanbul Winds, and Coral Dreams, each reflecting both corporate history and the evolution of urban memory over time. Spanning 220 square meters and over 60 million pixels, it's one of Anadol's largest three works. Anadol expressed that it is a great honor to return to Istanbul with a work that resonates with the cultural and natural rhythm of the city.
The opening event took place on October 8, hosted by Suzan Sabancı at Akbank Headquarters.
October 19, 2024
RELATED ARTIST
REFİK ANADOL

================================================================================
PILEVNELI IS AT ARTWEEKS @AKARETLER | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/65/
Snapshot: 20260313045428

PILEVNELI is pleased to announce the participation to the 8th Edition of Artweeks @Akaretler.
The Artweeks@Akaretler PİLEVNELİ presentation, which will take place between November 3-16, will feature works by Refik Anadol, Banu Anka, Wim Delvoye, Ali Elmacı, Tim Kent, Daniel Knorr, Arik Levy, Lottermann & Fuentes, Julian Mayor, Mehmet & Kazım, Bjarne Melgaard, Frank Nitsche, Serkan Sarıer, Sucuk & Bratwurst, Ali Emir Tapan, Defne Tesal, Tarık Töre and Yuşa Yalçıntaş.
The presentation includes a series of three different ice cream-themed bronze sculptures inspired by the Sucuk & Bratwurst collective’s love for Italian coffee and ice cream culture, as well as the artists’ design titled “Alien Chair”.
As part of the exhibition, ice cream will be served at the venue by Vero Gelato.
Wim Delvoye’s series titled “Rorschach”, which is included in the Artweeks selection, reinterprets the visual richness of the Rorschach Test, which has become an important part of psychology and has inspired many artists, through sculpture, and radically revives and transforms the 19th century sculpture.
Ali Elmacı addresses the dilemma between good and evil, humanity and monstrosity in his painting series titled “You Are All Vampires, Including Me”.
In this series, he questions the moral values ​​and ethical beliefs of individuals.
While the vampire figures represent a world where boundaries are unclear, the artist emphasizes the power dynamics and power struggles within society, economic inequalities and issues related to social class differences.
PİLEVNELİ’s Artweeks@Akaretler presentation can be viewed at Sıraevler No: 41 between November 3-16, 2023.
October 31, 2023

URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/66/
Snapshot: 20260311050310

The exhibition, which will be held with the main sponsorship of Bilgili Holding, which makes valuable contributions to the cultural and artistic life of Istanbul, and the corporate sponsorship of Yapı Kredi Private Banking, will jointly undertake the architectural design in order to bring together different galleries under a common language, while TBWA will provide communication and corporate identity support.
AVANT D’ART will handle the video content development strategy and documentation, and Yöntem Communications will handle public relations.
The event is organized with the advertising and promotion support of İBB Kültür AŞ and Şişli Municipality.
Jaguar, which Borusan Otomotiv is the distributor of in Turkey, will be the transportation sponsor of the event.
The Art Talks of the event will be supported by Tosyalı Holding.
iyzico, Knauf, Damat Tween and Nart Sigorta ve Reasürans Brokerliği, as well as Vestel, Kalebodur, Jotun, Zuhal Müzik, Atelier Rebul, Yunus Karma, Mozaik, Mudo Concept, House of Beadzz, Duran Doğan Packaging, ABC Deterjan, Elta360 x ArtPick, Republika Aparts, TOST, 400°C Pizza, Bakırkazan, Uludağ and Prosense Güvenlik are providing support in various areas.
The media sponsorship of the event is undertaken by Aposto, ArtDog, ARTtv, Binat Architecture Media Group, Canvas Magazine, Eventmag, Gentleman, Hello!, ICON dooh, L'Officiel Türkiye, Maison Française, Marketing Türkiye, Oggusto, Oksijen, Panoffect, Strolling Istanbul, Şalom Gazetesi, XXI Mimarlık and YUZU.
In addition, visitors will be able to benefit from various services provided by Minoa, Momo and The Whirl Roastery, which provide support throughout the event.

================================================================================
:mentalKLINIK'S SOLO EXHIBITION "GENERATED DREAMS" AT SABRINA AMRANI GALLERY, MADRID | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/71/
Snapshot: 20260312065943

PREVIOUS
Next
There are only a few days left to visit mentalKLINIK’s Generated Dreams exhibition at Sabrina Amrani Gallery, Madrid! The exhibition, featuring works such as Billie and Valentine, will be open to visitors until November 19.
Billie and Valentine: two haunting, hollow human figures. They sit in stillness, indifferent and oblivious to our presence, detached from the world around them. Their bodies curl inward, faces hidden behind curtains of hair. Untouchable. Clad in the latest fashion, their appearance is meticulous even though their bodies appear to be of no use. Screens have nearly replaced physical experience, with avatars living out our lives on our behalf. Happiness in an instagram post, click-and-share indignation, online activism, immaterial shopping bags and digital hook-ups; everything quantifiable in likes and visibility. Human awareness becomes a mere hallucination.
November 13, 2024
RELATED ARTIST
:mentalKLINIK

TARIK TÖRE IS PART OF THE GROUP EXHIBITION “OTHERSIDE” IN WEST HOLLYWOOD, CALIFORNIA! | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/73/
Snapshot: 20260421155017

“Töre’s painted compositions distill elements of skate, internet, and pop culture, politics, and art history into grid-like maps of collective memory. In his “physical graffiti” series, seemingly disparate symbols float alongside each other; a butterfly next to a gun, Bugs Bunny next to the Grim Reaper. Situated together, these natural and imagined subjects mirror the way contemporary information channels are constantly saturated with a motley amalgamation of innocence, pleasure, and violence.”
Otherside, featuring works by Tarık Töre, Wyatt Mills, and Alex Milhako, is on view at 8714 Santa Monica Blvd until December 26, 2024 at MEY Gallery.

59

================================================================================
PİLEVNELİ IS PLEASED TO ANNOUNCE THE REPRESENTATION OF KEVIN FRANCIS GRAY!
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/74/
Snapshot: 20260614005815

PİLEVNELİ is happy to announce the representation of
Kevin Francis Gray
!
Kevin Francis Gray, known for his distinctive approach to Italian marble, redefines the relationship between abstraction, figuration, and portraiture beyond the confines of classical sculptural traditions. He transforms marble’s inherent qualities—its hardness, stillness, and coldness—into compelling attributes, unlocking the possibilities within the material. His sculptures achieve a seamless balance between concave and convex movements, challenging perceptions of marble as rigid or static.
Born in 1972 in Armagh, Northern Ireland, Gray studied at the National College of Art and Design in Dublin, the School of the Art Institute of Chicago, and Goldsmiths, University of London. His sculptures have been exhibited in venues such as the Royal Academy in London, the Tel Aviv Museum of Art, and the Museo d’Arte Contemporanea in Saint-Étienne. Gray lives and works between London and Pietrasanta.
Photo: Joe Petini
November 22, 2024
RELATED ARTIST
KEVIN FRANCIS GRAY

YOU ARE INVITED TO CELEBRATE THE OPENING OF OUR NEW EXHIBITION, VIEWING ROOM, TOGETHER! | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/77/
Snapshot: 20260610070751

PİLEVNELİ has been welcoming visitors to its Dolapdere venue with
Viewing Room
since November 26. This special compilation features works from the gallery’s inventory, including both previously exhibited pieces and others that have never been shown to the public before.
Throughout December, the exhibition invites visitors to experience a gallery concept that goes beyond the traditional confines of an exhibition space, utilizing the spatial possibilities of PİLEVNELİ Dolapdere. The works are displayed across all levels of the gallery using a hybrid approach that combines traditional exhibition methods with storage-inspired arrangements.
Viewing Room
decodes the relationship between art, time, and space from an unorthodox lens. You can visit the exhibition at PİLEVNELİ Dolapdere until December 28.
In addition, we would be delighted to welcome you to join us in celebrating our exhibition during a special showcase on Saturday, December 7, from 12:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m., accompanied by aperitifs.
For further information, please contact us at info@pilevneli.com.

:MENTALKLINIK AT FLOW GALLERY IN MADAGASCAR FOR “HOME ALMOST HOME” GROUP EXHIBITION CURATED BY JOËL ANDRIANOMEARISOA | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/78/
Snapshot: 20260615015255

:mentalKLINIK is participating in the
HOME ALMOST HOME
group exhibition, curated by Joël Andrianomearisoa, at Flow Gallery in Madagascar.
The exhibition, offering a fresh interpretation of Joël Andrianomearisoa’s globally recognized concept, is being held in Antananarivo, the capital of Madagascar, following previous shows in Paris, Chicago, and Madrid.
HOME ALMOST HOME
explores the idea of home not just as a physical space but as a place where emotions and memories converge.
While reflecting an unconventional approach to the concept of “home” the exhibition is enriched by contributions from internationally recognized artists like :mentalKLINIK. The bold visual language of :mentalKLINIK stands out, while the dialogue with works by other artists transforms the exhibition into a multi-layered experience.
The collaboration between Andrianomearisoa and :mentalKLINIK invites art lovers to transcend time and space. Providing an unforgettable contribution to Madagascar’s contemporary art scene,
HOME ALMOST HOME
will be on display at Flow Gallery from November 22, 2024, to January 21, 2025.

REFIK ANADOL CLIMBS TO 57TH SPOT ON POWER 100 LIST! | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/79/
Snapshot: 20260610070624

Refik Anadol continues to make waves in the international art scene. This year, he climbed to the 57th spot on ArtReview’s annual Power 100 list. Having ranked 60th on the same list last year, Anadol has proven his growing influence in the art world.
ArtReview highlights Anadol’s work, which brings together digital art, big data, and artificial intelligence technologies, emphasizing his innovative approach in these fields. Notably, his piece “Unsupervised,” exhibited at New York’s Museum of Modern Art (MoMA) and recognized as the first digital artwork to be included in the museum’s permanent collection, underscores the artist’s success. Additionally, his contributions to the Sphere project in Las Vegas and his projection work on Barcelona’s Casa Batlló stand out as significant milestones in his career.
The ArtReview Power 100 list, published annually, showcases the most influential figures and trends in contemporary art. Beyond highlighting artworks, the list delves into the infrastructure, interpersonal dynamics, and societal impacts that shape the art world. Reflecting the global dynamics of contemporary art, this ranking offers valuable insights into the production, visibility, and influence of art. Refik Anadol’s rise on the list underscores both his individual success and the growing prominence of digital art in the contemporary art landscape.
December 6, 2024

REFIK ANADOL AT GUGGENHEIM BILBAO! | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/80/
Snapshot: 20260614001805

Guggenheim Bilbao will host Refik Anadol’s captivating, architectural, and multisensory work from March 7 to October 19, 2025. The museum will welcome Anadol as the first artist in the
in situ
exhibition series. The exhibition will invite visitors to reshape their perceptions of the physical world, public art, and the boundaries of creativity.
2025 promises to be a significant year for Refik Anadol, not only for this exhibition but also with the opening of
Dataland
in Los Angeles. Located in
The Grand LA
, a building designed by Frank Gehry,
Dataland
will be the world’s first AI art museum, blending AI and data visualization technologies with art. Led by Anadol, this project will offer an interactive experience and present a new vision for the future of art.
Anadol’s two major projects are closely tied to Gehry’s architectural vision. By dedicating his Guggenheim Bilbao work to Gehry, Anadol honors his contributions to modern architecture while merging his artistic vision with Gehry’s spaces.

REFIK ANADOL IN TIME100 IMPACT AWARDS! | PİLEVNELİ
URL: https://www.pilevneli.com/news/82/
Snapshot: 20260614001605

Organized by TIME magazine, the TIME100 Impact Awards is a prestigious program that honors visionary leaders across various fields. From scientists and artists to technology pioneers and activists, these awards recognize individuals who not only achieve remarkable success in a given year but also create a lasting impact. Since its launch in 2022, the event has highlighted global changemakers, emphasizing their enduring contributions to society.
According to
an article published on TIME’s website
, one of this year’s award recipients is Refik Anadol, who utilizes artificial intelligence as an artistic tool to merge data with aesthetics. The magazine highlights Anadol’s ability to transform vast datasets into dynamic, immersive artworks, bringing digital art to a wider audience. His groundbreaking projects, including
Unsupervised
—the first generative AI artwork acquired by MoMA—and his large-scale data sculpture at the Las Vegas Sphere, have drawn significant attention. Additionally, the article mentions his upcoming AI art museum,
Dataland
, set to open in Los Angeles in 2025, as a key milestone in his career.
